title: 2.5 Dimensional Seduction
synopsis:
“I have no interest in real girls!” 

So claims Okumura, the president of the school’s manga club. He’s your typical otaku, obsessed with a sexy (fictional) 2D manga character known as Lilliel. Then the new school year starts, and a (real!) 3D girl named Lilysa whose passion is cosplay joins the club. Lilysa convinces Okumura to become her photographer–and guess who her favorite manga character is? Not only that, but Lilysa is into modeling the fetishy stuff! The boundaries between 2D and 3D start to blur as this hot-blooded romantic comedy unfolds.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

episodes.title: New Student from Another Dimension
episodes.synopsis:
Okumura may not be interested in 3D girls, but he’s surprised when he discovers that he and Ririsa share similar passions.

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: Cosplay Group Potential?
episodes.synopsis:
Mikari is a new student at school and all the boys are crazy for her since she's a model. She also happens to be Okumura's childhood friend.

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: Lili x Miri
episodes.synopsis:
Mikari doesn't get why Okumura and Ririsa love cosplay, but she's willing to give it a shot if it means winning the heart of the boy she loves.

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: Time For Our First Event!
episodes.synopsis:
Okumura and Ririsa head to their first cosplay event, but all they can think about is how much this feels like a date!

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: First Event Is Over!!
episodes.synopsis:
Ririsa dazzles the entire venue with her amazing Lilliel cosplay, but now she and Okumura need to handle her newfound popularity.

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: Tips From a Master!?
episodes.synopsis:
There’s a special bond between cosplayers and photographers, one that Mikari can’t help but be jealous of.

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: We Need an Advisor!
episodes.synopsis:
The Manga Club needs an advisor or else Okumura and Ririsa will lose their clubroom! The new teacher could help, especially since she seems very familiar…

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: Do You Love Cosplay?
episodes.synopsis:
Okumura and Ririsa don't want to hide their activities from the school and decide to participate in an upcoming cosplay event as an official club activity.

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: You're Not Liliel!
episodes.synopsis:
Nagomi is the star of the event, and her words shook Ririsa to her very core. Now it is up to Okumura, Mayuri and the others to restore her confidence.

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: Nagomi vs Mayura!!
episodes.synopsis:
The legendary Mayura has returned, and now two Queens of Cosplay square off during the photoshoot.

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: My Enchanted Armor
episodes.synopsis:
Nagomi realizes she can just have fun with cosplay, just like Ririsa. When the two cosplayers meet later on, a new friendship blooms.

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: Five Rising Stars
episodes.synopsis:
The good news is that the Manga Club can keep the club room! The bad news is that their cosplay activities must remain a secret.

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: Can We Be Friends?
episodes.synopsis:
Nonoa wishes to befriend Ririsa, but the rising star of the cosplay world has a big problem: her social skills are non-existent.

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: Together With You
episodes.synopsis:
Okumura and Nonoa have a heart-to-heart. Perhaps it will give the shy cosplayer the courage to clear up the misunderstanding between her and Ririsa.

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: I'll Keep Evolving
episodes.synopsis:
Ririsa and Nonoa have cleared up their misunderstanding and are now friends. While memories of her middle school experiences linger, Nonoa is determined to move forward.

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: Your Way, My Way
episodes.synopsis:
Aria certainly has potential, but her costume seriously lacks substance. Now, it’s up to the Manga Club to give her a crash course in cosplay and all things otaku!

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: Comrades in (Cosplay) Arms
episodes.synopsis:
Aria confides in the Manga Club about her estranged father and her passion for cosplay. Touched by her story, the club members vow to help Aria accomplish her dream.

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: Destiny
episodes.synopsis:
The Manga Club rallies around a devastated Aria after she breaks the news. Fortunately, Okumura can’t help but feel there’s more to the story than what Aria overheard.

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: Time for Summer Comiket
episodes.synopsis:
The Manga Club arrive at Summer Comiket and are determined to give their cosplay their all! Unfortunately, cosplaying as a group is harder than it looks.

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: The World We Create with Our Friends
episodes.synopsis:
Coordination isn’t their only problem. The Manga Club must also deal with the bane of cosplayers everywhere: heat.

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: The Protagonist's Story
episodes.synopsis:
Ten years is a long time to dwell on guilt. An estranged father’s regrets, and a determined daughter’s wish are about to arrive at a crossroads.

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: This Wonderful World
episodes.synopsis:
Okumura and Ririsa happen to be alone together for once, but that doesn’t mean it’s now a date, right?

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: Manga Club on the Beach
episodes.synopsis:
Okumura realizes he needs to understand his friends more, and what better place to do so than at the beach?

(Source: HIDIVE)

episodes.title: 2.5-Dimensional Ririsa
episodes.synopsis:
Love is messy and doesn’t work in real life like it does in anime. When Okumura overhears a heartfelt conversation, he worries what it means for the future.

(Source: HIDIVE)
